snippet.title: Cozy Organizer - Wholesome Item Organizing & Decorating - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Organize, decorate, align, and stack items in cozy environments, just like those TikTok videos. Cozy Organizer is a cute, wholesome sandbox organizing game, where your OCD feels right at home! From stacking perfect pantries to designing dream closets, enjoy colorful graphics and relaxing tunes.

Play the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415240/Cozy_Organizer/
